info.name: Mist Admins Orgs Stats - Assets API

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: page
params.description: Select the page number to return when using page-based pagination; starts at `1`

items.docs: List BLE asset location and advertisement statistics for the organization over an optional time window, including map coordinates, RSSI, zones, and iBeacon or Eddystone fields.

params.name: distinct
params.description: Field used to group this count response. enum: `ibeacon_major`, `ibeacon_minor`, `ibeacon_uuid`, `mac`, `map_id`, `site_id`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

items.docs: Count organization asset statistics grouped by a distinct asset attribute, such as MAC address, site, map, iBeacon UUID, iBeacon major, or iBeacon minor.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Filter results by site identifier

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter results by MAC address. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: device_name
params.description: Filter asset results by reporting device name

params.name: name
params.description: Filter results by name. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: map_id
params.description: Filter results by map identifier

params.name: ibeacon_uuid
params.description: Filter asset results by iBeacon UUID. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: ibeacon_major
params.description: Filter asset results by iBeacon major value. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: ibeacon_minor
params.description: Filter asset results by iBeacon minor value. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: eddystone_uid_namespace
params.description: Filter asset results by Eddystone UID namespace

params.name: eddystone_uid_instance
params.description: Filter asset results by Eddystone UID instance

params.name: eddystone_url
params.description: Filter asset results by Eddystone URL

params.name: ap_mac
params.description: Filter asset results by reporting AP MAC address. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: beam
params.description: Filter asset results by beam value. Accepts multiple comma-separated integer values.

params.name: rssi
params.description: Filter asset results by RSSI value. Accepts multiple comma-separated integer values.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search BLE asset statistics with filters for site, MAC address, asset name, map, iBeacon or Eddystone identifiers, reporting AP MAC address, RSSI, beam, and time range. Supports pagination and sorting.
